title: Ah! fuggi il traditor!
subtitle: Donna Elvira: aria from Don Giovanni, Act 1 (No. 8)

passages.label: Ah! fuggi il traditor! … fallace il ciglio!
Da miei tormenti impara … dal mio periglio
Ah fuggi, fuggi! (again, to the end)

licences.source: W. A. Mozart, Don Giovanni, K. 527 (1787), Act 1 scene 10, No. 8 Aria
licences.author: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart (1756–1791)

licences.source: Lorenzo Da Ponte, libretto of Don Giovanni (1787)
licences.author: Lorenzo Da Ponte (1749–1838)
licences.notes: Words as printed in the Schirmer vocal score (Da miei, where the libretto has Da' miei).

licences.source: G. Schirmer vocal score, New York 1900 (plate 15147, IMSLP #68957), pages 69–71, bars 1–45 of No. 8
licences.author: G. Schirmer, piano reduction as printed
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: the sung line and the piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge, then checked bar by bar and checked again by a fresh checker. The English singing translation and the stage direction are left out. Playback tempo: ♩ = 105, about 1:17, the median of five complete recordings (Fricsay 1958 1:06, Giulini 1959 1:17, C. Davis 1973 1:10, Böhm 1977 1:23, Karajan 1985 1:18); Mozart gives the word Allegro only.
